name: Applied Epistemic Engineering (the AEE engine)
role: The engine: takes claims as input and computes verdicts mechanically. This repo also hosts the program ledger, the matrix generator, and the gate.

name: Spec Kit AEE extension
role: The Spec Kit extension that wires the engine into specification-driven development workflows.

name: Spec Kit evaluator
role: Mechanical evaluation of spec structure and results; part of the engine surface for this program.

name: Spec Kit AEE benchmark harness
role: The measuring instrument: runs the frozen task pairs, grades deliveries, settles spend, and produces the run records the ledger cites.

name: Injection defense
role: The message-security line: design, battery, and corpus for the epistemic defense against prompt injection.
